reasons: Both answers meet every rubric item with nearly identical reasoning: the pre-workout's caffeine, the half-life arithmetic, adenosine blockade, melatonin as a timing signal, and a firm no on phenibut. B adds a few useful extras: a clearer explanation of why a higher melatonin dose will not help, a warning not to swap caffeine for other stimulants such as synephrine or yohimbine, a pointer to CBT-I as first-line treatment, and a source (Drake 2013) for the caffeine effect. A's protocol table is slightly inconsistent, since its fallback of at most 100 mg of caffeine no later than 16:00 conflicts with the 18:45 time listed in the same row.
